name: Breakwater Salvage Union
backstory: Salt-worn salvage machines earn the union's facility budget. A protected tug, a heavy clamp and a distant recovery platform turn repaired work equipment into three arena roles.
strategy_personality: Salt-worn copper and steel; tracked tug, clamp-armed salvager, heavy recovery machine; facility-led growth that retains visibly repaired equipment. Develop distinct mechanical construction and silhouettes; colour changes alone do not justify separate portraits.
